mapping.control_definition_clause: Measure the presence of a completed or binding debt/credit facility of the issuer or an explicitly consolidated subsidiary whose contractual principal maturity is strictly after the as-of calendar date and no later than 90 calendar days afterward. Use the latest disclosed effective amendment for the same facility. Distinguish principal maturity from fee/interest/collateral/optional redemption dates, proposals, uncommitted funding and third-party customer debt.
mapping.definition_requires: Use latest effective disclosed amendment for a relied-on facility and do not treat fee/collateral/interest/optional-redemption dates as principal maturity.
mapping.definition_does_not_require: Enumerating all non-selected facilities or discussing BlackRock when selecting only a correctly identified qualifying Ancora facility.
